title: Synonymous Sentences
description: Generate all possible synonymous sentences given a list of synonym pairs.
pseudocode:
1. Build adjacency list of synonyms
2. Use DFS to generate all combinations
3. Sort result list lexicographically

steps.note: Building synonym map: {happy: [joy], joy: [happy], cheerful: [glad], glad: [cheerful]}
DFS path 1: starting with 'happy', replaces with 'joy'
